test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As the river enters the plain it get twists and turns forming large bends known as ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is meanders.

 
• Meanders:
 
• Meanders are bends in a waterway or river.
 
• They form when moving water in a stream erodes the outer banks and widens its valley, and the inner part of the river has less energy and deposits what it is carrying.
 
• Over time, the meanders become more exaggerated.
 
• Ox-bow:
 
• An oxbow is a U-shaped body of water that forms when a wide meander from the main stem of a river is cut off, creating a free-standing body of water.
 
• This landform is named for its distinctive curved shape, which is similar to the yoke used to harness oxen.
 
• Levees:
 
• Levees are natural embankments which are built up along the edges of a river channel.
 
• During flood stages, water deposits sediment on the river banks, creating levees.
 
• They act as barriers against floodwater and are also often reinforced by humans in areas prone to flooding.
 
• Stack:
 
• A stack is a geological landform consisting of a steep and often vertical column or columns of rock in the sea near a coast, formed by wave erosion.
 
• Stacks are formed over time by wind and water, processes of coastal geomorphology.
